text: 截至午盘，上证指数涨0.03%，深证成指跌0.58%，创业板指跌0.92%，北证50涨1.18%。三市成交额13612亿元，较上日放量405亿元。全市场超3500家个股上涨。 板块题材上，粮食概念、乳业、短剧游戏板块涨幅居前；电子化学品、元件板块跌幅居前。 盘面上，粮食概念全线爆发，万向德农6连板，新赛股份4连板，新华百货、京粮控股、敦煌种业、隆平高科、供销大集、深粮控股、金健米业、农发种业、神农种业、登海种业涨停，康农种业涨超15%，秋乐种业、绿亨科技涨超10%。乳业板块持续走高，金健米业涨停，欢乐家、大北农、骑士乳业、一鸣食品、新农开发跟涨。短剧游戏
text_en: As of midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.03%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.58%, the ChiNext Index fell 0.92%, and the Beijing Stock Exchange 50 rose 1.18%. Total turnover across the three markets reached 1.3612 trillion yuan, up 40.5 billion yuan from the previous day. More than 3,500 stocks rose across the market. By sector, food concepts, dairy, and short-drama games led gains, while electronic chemicals and components lagged. In trading, food concepts surged broadly, with Wandong Denong hitting a six-day limit-up and Xinsai Shares a four-day limit-up. Xinhua Department Store, Jingliang Holdings, Dunhuang Seed, Longping High-Tech, Gongxiao Daji, Shenzhen Cereals Holdings, Jinjian Rice, Nongfa Seed, Shennong Seed, and Denghai Seed all hit limit-up. Kangnong Seed rose over 15%, while Qiule Seed and Lyheng Technology gained over 10%.
